stemMd: A trolley starts from rest with constant acceleration 3 m/s squared. How far does it travel in 4 s?
explanationMd: From rest with constant acceleration, displacement is one half times acceleration times time squared. Thus 0.5 times 3 times 16=24 m. Average speed is 6 m/s, giving the same distance.

distractorRationale.a: This uses neither the correct time dependence nor units.
distractorRationale.c: This uses a²t = 3² × 4 = 36 instead of the required displacement formula at²/2.
distractorRationale.d: This is the final speed's numerical value, not distance.
distractorRationale.e: This omits the one-half in the displacement formula.
